core.headline: New three-bedroom semi-detached home, Kings Hill, West Malling
core.listing:
A new-build three-bedroom semi-detached house (The Larch) at Orchard Rise, Kings Hill, West Malling, with completion expected spring 2027. The property is freehold and offered with no onward chain. Air source heat pump heating with underfloor heating to the ground floor, an EV charging point and a 10-year NHBC warranty are included.

The ground floor provides a living room measuring 4.90m x 3.30m (16'1" x 10'10") and a kitchen/dining room measuring 5.80m x 3.40m (19'0" x 11'2"). On the first floor, the principal bedroom measures 4.10m x 3.00m (13'5" x 9'10") and has an en-suite, and there are two further bedrooms and a family bathroom.

Outside, there is a turfed rear garden with a patio and two allocated parking spaces with an EV charging point.

West Malling station is approx. 2 miles away. FTTP broadband is available.

Fixed Price £410,000 for the freehold. Council Tax: not yet banded (Tonbridge and Malling Borough Council). EPC rating: B. Construction: Standard – Brick and block under a tiled roof. Mains electricity, water (metered) and sewerage. Heating: Air source heat pump; underfloor heating downstairs, radiators upstairs. EPC B is a predicted rating (SAP); the final EPC will be issued on completion. Reservation fee £1,500, deducted from the price on completion; refundable less a £250 administration fee if the buyer withdraws within 28 days, otherwise non-refundable. Estate charge £295 per year to the management company for communal open space. Developer contribution of £5,000 towards flooring for reservations by 30 November 2026.
